<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Living Tar](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3128)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Most often found belowground, these oozes scour caves for objects to dissolve with their corrosive secretions. These sticky masses are often filled with bones, fossils, and discarded weaponry from adventurers.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Ooze](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44)): DC 23

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 21

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Living_Tar.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 7">[Living Tar](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3128)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Huge" />
<trait label="Mindless" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=652" />
<trait label="Ooze" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=665" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 257

**Perception** +9; motion sense ([precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411)) 60 feet, no vision

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +18

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +7

**Dex** -5

**Con** +7

**Int** -5

**Wis** +0

**Cha** -5
</row>

**Motion Sense** A living  tar can feel nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 14 

**Fort** +18 

**Ref** +6 

**Will** +11 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 165

</row>

**Immunities**
[acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524), bleed, bludgeoning, critical hits, [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), precision, [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)

**Adhesive Mass** A weapon that hits the living tar is stuck to the ooze. Removing it requires a successful DC 23 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check to [Break Open](/Actions.aspx?ID=2375). The living tar can have any number of objects or creatures stuck to it at a time. It can release a stuck object with an Interact action, and the adhesive dissolves 1 minute after the ooze dies, releasing all stuck objects and creatures.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, climb 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
pseudopod +18 ([reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 2d8+7 bludgeoning plus 2d6 acid and [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**[Constrict](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=57)** <actions string="Single Action" />  1d8+7 bludgeoning plus 1d6 acid, DC 26

**[Engulf](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=61)** <actions string="Three Actions" />  DC 22, 4d6 acid, [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) DC 22, Rupture 15

</column>

<document level="2" id="creature-family-453" />
name: Living Tar
